samples.question: The picture shows two square plates side by side, each enclosed by a coloured frame and each printed with a fine black-and-white speckle. Both plates cover the same 7 rows and 7 columns of equal square cells, and the two plates are the same size, so every cell of the right plate has one matching cell of the left plate. The right plate repeats the left plate's speckle cell by cell, in one of two ways. In a plain cell the speckle is copied straight across, so that cell of the right plate is exactly the matching cell of the left plate. In a slid cell the speckle is copied from further to the right: what the right plate shows at a point of a slid cell is what the left plate shows the slide distance further right of the matching point, in the same row. The slide distance is the same in every slid cell and is printed above the plates as the distance between the two small coloured tick marks. Each row of the left plate is a loop, so a strip that runs past its right edge continues from its left edge. Neither plate on its own shows anything but speckle; only comparing them tells the slid cells from the plain ones. On the 7 by 7 grid the slid cells form a shape that most closely matches one of these five symbols: crescent, funnel, pinwheel, spiral, staircase. Which symbol is it? Answer with one word.
